geometry_scan.feasibility_contract: existing shank-table clearance >= 0; no added margin

notes: The audit grid is fixed before dynamic execution and includes expected out-of-support negative-side points to locate the execution boundary.
The final grid refines the coarse attempt-01 positive-side bracket r=0.50 pass / r=0.75 contact before the self-contained final validation run.
The accepted interval is the widest contiguous run of passing audit points contained in the continuously geometry-feasible component that includes r=0.
Cuff force and moment are observation-only and never enter support selection.
Finite dynamic samples support an engineering interval; they are not a formal guarantee for every real-valued r.
